metadata.description: Ground Truth scores computed from raw polygon data using spec-compliant formulas
metadata.evaluator: contest_evaluate.py spec formulas (HPWL_int bbox, HPWL_ext centroid)
metadata.baseline: Fresh-computed from GT positions (NOT using pre-stored metrics[0] or metrics[-2])

summary.note: HPWL_gap = 0 and Area_gap = 0 by construction (GT vs GT). Cost = exp(beta * V_rel). Violations are real GT constraint violations.
